transcript: My friend, trauma is not the story of what happened to you. Trauma is the quiet storm that happened inside you because of it. It is the spiritual wound you were never prepared to carry. This is the first truth. The second truth is this. A wound has two faces. When the wound is still open, even the softest touch feels like fire. Someone says a small word, someone makes a small movement, and your whole body reacts as if it has been hurt all over again. Not because you are weak, but because the wound is still raw, still living. And then there is the scar. It forms to protect you, but it becomes thick, stiff, unable to grow. It numbs you. It disconnects you from your own heart because feeling everything fully would hurt too much. This is the nature of trauma. It makes us too sensitive to what touches us, and at the same time, it makes us unable to feel what is inside us. But listen to me, my friend. You do not have to stay wounded or numb. Healing is possible. Peace is possible. Your softness can return. If you are ready to begin this inner repair and learn real practices to heal the wound inside, join me in the 30-day healing journey. I will guide you step by step back to yourself.
